oracleRisk.summary: MXNT native issuer minting and peso-par redemption do not use a borrower collateral oracle or variable token NAV. Shared-book reserve valuations and USD/MXN monitoring quotes are distinct from the token's mint and redemption price authority.

branchApplicability.rationale: The exact Ethereum TetherToken accepts owner-authorized mint amounts rather than price-dependent collateral inputs. MXNT is a fixed-peso fiat-token obligation, not a borrower position or variable-NAV share; reserve portfolio valuation is reviewed separately under Backing.

applicability.rationale: Owner-only mint and fixed-peso issuer redemption have no borrower-liquidation or variable token-NAV price input. Implementation and owner were pinned at Ethereum block 26197399 (2026-10-15T10:44:59Z).

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum is the issuer's currently supported native MXNT deployment. The official integration roster places Tron MXNT under deprecated protocols and the issuer feed reports zero Tron tokens. The 2022 launch named Polygon but the current official roster supplies no Polygon MXNT address. No third-party bridge or exhaustive historical liability partition is asserted.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197399 (2026-10-15T10:44:59Z), the proxy implementation is 0x4c0d2c74a8d26f1e4f5653021c521f5471f9e566 and the token owner is the pinned 3-of-6 wallet. Its runtime exactly matches the retrieved verified TetherToken source. WithBlockedList exposes onlyOwner addToBlockedList and removeFromBlockedList; TetherToken exposes onlyOwner destroyBlockedFunds. Transfers reject blocked callers and transferFrom also rejects blocked senders. The owner can therefore directly block outgoing transfers and destroy blocked balances, while immediate upgrades retain replacement authority. Issuer account verification applies to primary mint/redemption; it is not an ordinary peer-to-peer transfer allowlist.
